title: Coast Guard rescues injured sea turtle
description: NEW YORK – Members from Riverhead Foundation for Marine Research and Preservation transport a severely injured 3-foot Loggerhead Sea Turtle into a container at Coast Guard Station Fire Island, July 10, 2014. The Coast Guard boatcrew recovered the turtle from Fire Island Inlet and transported it back to the station before it was transferred to the foundation members. U.S. Coast Guard video by Seaman Owen Rosenthal.
